input.quote: 18.1 Vendor shall maintain, at its own expense throughout the term and for one year afterward, commercial general liability insurance of at least USD 1,000,000 per occurrence and USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, employer's liability of USD 1,000,000, professional errors and omissions insurance of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability insurance of USD 5,000,000.
input.rationale: Section 18 imposes the insurance programme on Vendor (Cobalt Cloud Services LLC), so the clause runs in our favour. Clause 18.1 meets the preferred position in full: CGL of USD 1,000,000 per occurrence / USD 2,000,000 aggregate, workers' compensation as required by law, professional errors and omissions of USD 2,000,000, and cyber and privacy liability of USD 5,000,000 (unconditional, so it covers this hosting vendor's processing of Customer Data), maintained through the term plus one year. Clause 18.2 supplies certificates of insurance and evidence of coverage on request, plus primacy, notice of cancellation and confirmation that insurance does not cap Vendor's liabilities. It also adds employer's liability of USD 1,000,000 above our ask. No other provision, schedule or precedence clause qualifies or reduces these limits. This sits at the preferred position, not merely the fallback, so no redline is warranted.
